facts.Primary Value: Capital + Customer / Pilot Access + Market Entry
facts.Foundshore Verdict: Strong fit for international AI companies entering the US.
facts.Focus: AI / Applied AI / Consumer AI / Enterprise AI / frontier technology
facts.Funding / Support: No guaranteed cash investment; fast-track Lightspeed partner meetings, investor dinners, coworking, mentorship, market-entry support
facts.Funding Trigger: Separate Lightspeed investment conversation for qualified companies
facts.Equity / Economic Terms: No published equity take / no guaranteed investment on program page
facts.Geography / Affiliation Restriction: Must currently operate outside US; $5M+ revenue or funds raised; NYC expansion commitment
facts.Official / Must-Have Requirements: At least $5M in revenue or funding raised; currently operating outside the US; demonstrated traction for an AI product or service; plans to establish NYC operations and grow to more than five team members within 24 months.
facts.Strong-to-Have: Enterprise customer references, a US expansion plan, a clear hiring plan and a strong funding or revenue history.
facts.On-site / Attendance: 12 months, including one year of dedicated NYC coworking for up to two people per company. Not a traditional residency, but establishing a NYC presence is encouraged.
facts.International Founder: Required profile — currently operating outside the US
facts.Visa / Relocation: Immigration guidance is included, but visa sponsorship is not promised. A US entity or US customers are not required before applying.
facts.Application Status: 2026 cohort started; rolling applications after deadline space permitting
facts.Deadline / Next Intake: Jan 16, 2026 deadline; rolling thereafter if space
facts.Application Materials: Company stage/traction, AI product, current geography, NYC expansion and hiring plan.
facts.Public Contact Name: Lightspeed / NYC AI Landing Pad team
facts.Foundshore Best Fit: AI companies operating primarily outside the US, with traction and NYC expansion plans, seeking US go-to-market, customer, investor and immigration guidance.
facts.Foundshore Not Fit: Pre-idea or pre-seed teams without traction; non-AI companies; companies already operating mainly in the US; teams not planning to build an NYC team within 24 months.
facts.Notes: A US market-entry program with customer, talent, immigration guidance and Lightspeed access; it does not guarantee funding.
